Package com.datastax.dse.driver.api.core.metadata.schema

Interface DseGraphTableMetadata

  • All Superinterfaces:
    Describable, DseRelationMetadata, DseTableMetadata, RelationMetadata, TableMetadata
    public interface DseGraphTableMetadata
extends DseTableMetadata
    Specialized table metadata, that handles the graph-specific properties introduced in DSE 6.8.

    This type only exists to avoid breaking binary compatibility. When the driver is connected to a DSE cluster, all the TableMetadata instances it returns can be safely downcast to this interface.
